title: Capture feedback as typed upstream/downstream evidence
when: A defect should teach later routing, perception, code or layout decisions.
do: Bind observation to source region, question/node ID and exact artifact hash.
Store expected behavior, suspected/supported cause, rubric version, attempts, route/prompt, failed outputs and actual cost/time.
Map a regression case to the existing evaluator contract; use null for unknowns.
check: No producer self-score becomes independent truth; no unmeasured savings or model training claim.
limitation: Backward propagation here is traceable error attribution and selective rebuild, not gradient training.
